_comment: WHAT we say. Every angle carries the measurement that earned its status. 'evidence' is not a rationale -- it is a number from a same-account control. assertsFacts must stay false: number claims are DERIVED from friendship.ts via scripts/derive-compatibility-pairs.mjs, never written here.

angles.summary: Which numbers are your best match
angles.evidence: @numberswithrimzim same-account control: compatibility 51.9K-57.2K views vs the same account's other posts at 6.8K-25.9K. The pinned 'made for each other' post took 35K likes on a 28.6K-follower account.

angles.summary: The numbers that get along with themselves -- and the one that does not
angles.evidence: Derived from friendship.ts: 7 is the only number not friendly to itself, and 5 is mutual only with itself. Held back from the compatibility reel as a second post; same positive frame as best-match, which is the measured winner.

angles.summary: A number people are taught to fear, corrected from our own ruleset
angles.evidence: PROMOTED hypothesis -> approved 2026-08-12 on V33, the first CURRENT-ERA, same-account, unconfounded-by-era test this angle has ever had. V33 'Moolank 2 -- Not Weak', read on Instagram ~1.5 days after posting: 1,268 views / 1,140 viewers, which Instagram itself ranked '1 of 10 latest' and labelled Viewers 'Higher', avg watch time 6.9s 'Higher', Follows 2 'Higher', skip rate 67.2% 'Lower' -- four of four headline metrics against the account's own baseline. Against its two immediate siblings in the same week and the same era: V32 (self-friendly, 08-10) 169 views / 137 reach, V30 (best-match, 08-10) 759 / 644. Shares went 0 (V30) and ~1 (V32) to 6 plus 4 reposts, and V33 took the account's FIRST non-zero comment in n~45. Prior instances, all still standing: V03 'Number 8 Is Not Unlucky' (2026-07-14) 1,924 views, avg watch 7s of 17s, skip rate 57.5% 'Lower'; V06 'Number 9 Is Not Angry' (2026-07-22); the 2026-08-07 card reel hooked '13 isn't unlucky' at 20 shares on 271 reach (7.4%) and 12.9% interaction against same-week same-format siblings M6R 178/0 and M5R 159/1 at 5.7-6.7%; the 2026-07-29 post that reached 499 on 126 shares.
angles.caveat: TWO LIVE CONFOUNDS, and neither is dischargeable from V33 alone. (1) V33 MOVED TWO THINGS vs V32 -- angle (self-friendly -> belief-correction) AND structure (standard 19.8s -> essay 23.2s). The win therefore belongs to the PACKAGE 'belief-correction + essay', not to the angle by itself; a replication holding essay fixed is what separates them. (2) V03's 1,924 views are CONFOUNDED WITH ERA -- before 2026-07-24 the account's median reach was 1,487, so a big number from 07-14 was never a clean control. What survives that confound is baseline-relative, and V33 is now the era-clean instance that V03 was not. NOTE ALSO: V33's 0-1s hold got WORSE, not better (~48% at 1s against V32's 63.2% and V30's 69.5%). The gain is entirely in the TAIL -- ~20% still watching at 15s where V32 was at 13.3% by 6s. This angle does not fix the first second; nothing has. It buys retention after the hook survives.

angles.summary: One number, its ruling planet and traits
angles.evidence: Our own card reels. TikTok ~205 views with 1-3 likes; Instagram 122-213 reach. @vediksoul's weakest format: 3.0K-24.6K against 348K-4.4M for topic-led posts. This is what 'our weakest format, competently made' looks like.

Conflict-framed posts measured 1,115-1,436 likes against the positive frame's 35K. The top-liked comment on one was a sceptic mocking the account. Also delivers a verdict ON the reader, which is why the Barnum hooks were rejected.

angles.summary: Your friend list and their friend list are not the same list
angles.evidence: NEW 2026-08-13, status hypothesis -- registered because belief-correction FAILED to replicate. V33 (Moolank 2) took 1,268 views/1,140 viewers; V34 held the entire package (same angle, essay, tempo, bed, 23.198s) on Moolank 1 and took 189/159, avg watch 3.8s vs 6.9s, skip 84.0% (Higher) vs 67.2% (Lower), 0 follows vs 2. Both held ~48% at 1s -- IDENTICAL hooks -- and diverged entirely in the tail: V33 ~20% at 15s, V34 ~5% from 3s on. So the hook replicated and the body did not. Derived from friendship.ts: a pair counts only when BOTH rows name the other, which is the exact distinction best-match DISCARDS ("one-way entries are excluded on purpose"). This angle publishes what best-match deliberately hid.
angles.caveat: UNMEASURED, n=0. Registered as `hypothesis`, NOT approved -- V33 is the standing warning against promoting an angle off one number. 3, 6 and 9 are the only numbers whose every match is mutual and they list only each other, so the 9 cut lands positive while the 8 cut lands on a real asymmetry; if 9 wins and 8 does not, that is a TOPIC effect, not an angle effect, and the same trap that produced V34. 7 is deliberately given the gentle cut (its mutual set is [2] alone and it is the only number not friendly to itself) -- BELIEF_CORRECTION_SEVEN refused to hand a 7 a verdict about being alone on the same table, and that refusal is inherited here. Also: all three ship on `centered` because the one-line character ceiling is layout-specific and only centered clears it, so layout is NOT a variation axis across this set.
